Listen to this article Share Real estate firm 1159 Realty has unveiled Nova Heights, a residential development in Lekki Scheme II, Abraham Adesanya, Lagos, as it seeks to deepen its presence in the state’s property market. The development was introduced at the company’s inaugural Realtors Escape, a networking event that brought together real estate professionals from Lagos, Oyo and Ogun states to strengthen industry partnerships and expand its sales network. The company stated that a structured pre-launch phase will run through December, with formal sales scheduled to begin in January. It also plans to organise an on-site inspection for participating realtors to familiarise them with the project and equip them with the information required to engage prospective buyers. Comfort Olugbami,Founder and Managing Director said Nova Heights reflects the company’s strategy to make property ownership more accessible and align its offerings with the needs of modern homebuyers and investors. “Nova Heights represents an important chapter in our journey as a company. We have always believed that real estate should be more accessible, more intentional, and more responsive to the aspirations of the people buying into it,” Olugbami stated. She added that the company’s expansion into Lagos was driven by its ambition to establish a distinct identity in the market, rather than simply add another development to its portfolio. entering Lagos simply to say that we have a Lagos property. We are entering with the ambition to build something people can identify with, believe in, and ultimately call home,” she noted. Olugbami also underscored the importance of quality and customer experience in building confidence among property buyers, stating that a focus on proper execution guarantees the best client experience. Founded in 2021, 1159 Realty initially focused on reducing barriers to entry for young and aspiring property investors. The company has since expanded its operations into land banking, premium residential development and agro-real estate. Its portfolio includes Cisca Villa, a residential construction and development project in Ibadan, and Johnny’s Gate II, a land-banking project in Malete. The firm has also introduced a resale marketplace that allows existing clients to list fully paid properties for resale. Beyond property development, 1159 Realty is investing in its realtor network through the Daring Tribe, a community comprising more than 700 active real estate professionals. Operating under the learn, earn and win model, the initiative provides training programmes, masterclasses, sales challenges and incentives aimed at strengthening professional capacity and creating sustained earning opportunities. The company stated that its relationship with realtors extends beyond individual transactions to include professional development and continued support. The initiative forms part of a broader strategy to combine property investment and development with real estate education, technology and community-building.
